newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Comms to name new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Comms to name new CFO.

text.p: Brendan Clouston, currently President and Chief Operating Officer of Tele-Communications Inc's domestic cable unit, will become Chief Financial Officer at the parent, a spokesman said on Tuesday.
"He will be moving over," the spokesman said.
The announcement ends speculation that Clouston was going to resign from the company following the appointment of Leo Hindery Jr. as president.
The CFO position has been vacant, the spokesman said.
The spokesman said he could not immediately confirm a published report that TCI told analysts in New York the company would be seeking partners as a way to cut debt.
